description: Python sidecar: emit loose per-attachment PNGs into an images/ folder next to the generated skeleton JSON, with a default-on toggle, stale-PNG pruning, and the folder name shared with writer.py's skeleton.images value so the two can never drift. Covers plan.md items 1-6. This is the root-cause fix; FEAT-002 (TypeScript plumbing) depends on the request/response key names chosen here.
steps: Create python/src/spine_psd/loose_images.py: LOOSE_IMAGES_DIR_NAME = "images"; DEFAULT_IMAGES_PATH derived as f"./{LOOSE_IMAGES_DIR_NAME}/"; images_path_for(dir_name) -> f"./{dir_name}/"; a LooseImages dataclass with dir: str, paths: list[str], removed: list[str]; write_loose_images(out_dir, images, dir_name=LOOSE_IMAGES_DIR_NAME) -> LooseImages. Import PIL lazily inside the function the way atlas_packer.compose_page does. Resolve the target folder, raise ValueError when it is not inside the resolved out_dir, mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True), save each images[name] as <name>.png converting to RGBA only when image.mode != "RGBA", then delete every other *.png directly in that folder (no recursion, non-PNG files and subdirectories untouched) and record the removals. Module docstring: the Spine editor's File -> Import Data resolves <skeleton.images>/<attachmentName>.png relative to the JSON and never reads the .atlas, so these files are what make editor import work; they are the unpacked per-part images, not crops of the packed page.
In python/src/spine_psd/writer.py, import DEFAULT_IMAGES_PATH from .loose_images and use it as the build_skeleton_json images_path default. The emitted value must stay exactly "./images/".

In python/src/spine_psd/pipeline.py, add emit_loose_images: bool = True to run_pipeline; add images_dir: str = "", image_paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) and stale_images_removed: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) to PipelineResult; pass images_path=images_path_for(LOOSE_IMAGES_DIR_NAME) into build_skeleton_json; after out_dir.mkdir(...) call write_loose_images(out_dir, images) when the toggle is on and fill the new fields from the result; when off, write and delete nothing and append the warning "Loose per-attachment images were not written, so the Spine editor's File -> Import Data will not resolve attachments; the atlas path (runtime/preview) is unaffected." Leave the compose_page / write_atlas_text / atlas.image.save block exactly as it is.

In python/src/spine_psd/cli.py, read emit_loose_images=bool(request.get("emitLooseImages", True)) in handle_psd_to_skeleton and pass it to run_pipeline; add imagesDir, imagePaths and staleImagesRemoved to the success data block; update the module docstring's request/response example to show emitLooseImages and the new response fields. Keep PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1 — the change is additive.

Add python/tests/test_loose_images.py in the style of python/tests/test_pipeline.py (plain classes, PIL images built inline, tmp_path): exact <attachment>.png names, RGBA mode and width/height matching the source images, re-run overwrites matching names, an unrelated cape.png is deleted and reported in removed, a non-PNG file and a subdirectory survive, and a dir_name escaping out_dir raises ValueError.

Extend TestRunPipeline in python/tests/test_pipeline.py: the folder is created at Path(result.skeleton_path).parent / "images"; the set of loose PNG stems equals the default-skin attachment keys read back from the written JSON AND equals set(result.region_names); skeleton["skeleton"]["images"] joined onto the JSON's own parent resolves to the created folder, including for a nested out_dir; emit_loose_images=False creates no folder and appends the warning.

Add a dedicated invariance test class in python/tests/test_pipeline.py: run the same document into two temp dirs with the toggle on and off, then assert the .atlas text, the .png bytes and the .json text are all identical — this pins the skeleton hash and every attachment x/y/width/height.
Extend python/tests/test_real_psd.py::TestPipelineOnRealPsd with a case asserting the loose PNGs for torso, head, arm_left and thigh_left exist and open as RGBA.
Run the verification commands, then commit locally on fix/loose-images-editor-import with a conventional-commit message, staging only the files named above.
acceptance_criteria: `uv run --project python pytest -q` passes with more tests than the 66-test baseline and no failures.
A pipeline run writes out_dir/images/<attachment>.png for every default-skin attachment, named from part.bone, and the stems equal both the skin attachment keys and the atlas region names.
The .atlas text, the page .png bytes and the skeleton .json text are byte-identical between emit_loose_images=True and False runs of the same document, proven by an assertion in the test suite.
run_pipeline(..., emit_loose_images=False) creates no images folder, deletes nothing, and returns the warning about editor import.
A stale cape.png left in the images folder is removed on the next run and reported in the result's stale_images_removed; a non-PNG file in the same folder is untouched.
The sidecar response for psd_to_skeleton contains imagesDir, imagePaths and staleImagesRemoved, and PROTOCOL_VERSION is still 1.
verification: uv run --project python pytest -q python/tests/test_loose_images.py python/tests/test_pipeline.py python/tests/test_real_psd.py

Protocol smoke test once demo/out/hero.psd exists (run demo/make-sample-psd.py through uv if needed): '{"command":"psd_to_skeleton","psdPath":"demo/out/hero.psd","outDir":"demo/out/cli-check"}' | uv run --project python spine-psd-sidecar — response carries imagesDir and six imagePaths; delete demo/out/cli-check afterwards
findings: SHIPPED CONTRACT for FEAT-002/003. Sidecar request key: "emitLooseImages" (boolean, read as bool(request.get("emitLooseImages", True)), so any JSON value is coerced; omit it to get the default ON). PROTOCOL_VERSION stays 1. Success response data gains exactly three additive keys: "imagesDir" (string, absolute resolved folder path, "" when the toggle is off), "imagePaths" (string[], absolute paths of the written <attachment>.png files, sorted by attachment name, [] when off) and "staleImagesRemoved" (string[]). NOTE for the TS summary line: staleImagesRemoved carries FILE NAMES ONLY (e.g. "cape.png"), not full paths, because it is a report field; imagesDir/imagePaths are full paths. Python names: PipelineResult.images_dir / .image_paths / .stale_images_removed, run_pipeline(..., emit_loose_images: bool = True, document=...) with the toggle inserted before `document`. New module python/src/spine_psd/loose_images.py exports LOOSE_IMAGES_DIR_NAME = "images", images_path_for(dir_name), DEFAULT_IMAGES_PATH = "./images/" (now writer.build_skeleton_json's images_path default; the emitted value is unchanged, verified by the existing writer test), LooseImages(dir, paths, removed) and write_loose_images(out_dir, images, dir_name=LOOSE_IMAGES_DIR_NAME). Stale pruning as implemented: prune AFTER writing, not before — every image is saved first, then the folder's direct entries are scanned once (no recursion) and any *.png (case-insensitive suffix) not among the names just written is unlinked and reported by name; non-PNG files, subdirectories and PNGs nested in subdirectories are untouched; a re-run with the same attachment set removes nothing. write_loose_images raises ValueError("The loose images folder ... is outside the output directory ...") unless the resolved target has the resolved out_dir among its parents, so dir_name values that are absolute or contain .. are refused (and so is dir_name == "."). Toggle off appends the exact plan warning to PipelineResult.warnings and writes/deletes nothing. Deviations from the plan: (1) None of substance. (2) loose_images.LooseImages fields are all defaulted (plan listed them without defaults) so the dataclass can be constructed empty. (3) PIL is imported lazily inside write_loose_images with a `# noqa: F401` comment — nothing from the module is referenced directly (image.save is called on the caller's object), the import is there to keep the Pillow dependency explicit and to surface ModuleNotFoundError that cli.py maps to DEPENDENCY_MISSING. Verification: `uv run --project python pytest -q` = 82 passed (baseline 66, +16). Protocol smoke test against demo/out/hero.psd returned imagesDir plus exactly six imagePaths (arm_left, arm_right, head, thigh_left, thigh_right, torso) with staleImagesRemoved empty; demo/out/cli-check deleted afterwards, demo/out/hero.psd left in place (git-ignored). npm was NOT touched: no TypeScript changed in this feature.
